# SW2URDF 2026-09-08 RC1 / 候选版

## English

### Changes since v20260906

- Shared **Simulation Settings** for OpenUSD and MJCF: choose a base mode and joint drive intent once, then enter each target's gains separately. Applied settings survive saving the assembly and restarting SolidWorks.
- Enter measured Link mass directly to calibrate the full inertia tensor without first resetting SW values. This never changes CAD component mass properties. Preview and export share the same resolved values; proportional mass/inertia scaling leaves the equivalent cuboid dimensions unchanged.
- Verify effective export coordinate and STL settings instead of treating a setter result as proof; restore coupled STL resolution settings in the effective order.
- Preserve the Link tree after a failed cancel/save, use case-sensitive Mimic matching, and isolate ROS-specific configuration failures from other targets.
- Fix initial DPI scaling, clipped controls, and dynamic simulation-tab layout.

### Tested scope

- Unchanged installer from source `a422ed7`, built September 7 and installed/tested remotely in SolidWorks 2023 SP1.
- Core: **129 passed**; official MuJoCo tests: **9 passed**; plug-in: **992 passed**, no failures or skips.
- Actual four-target export: **4 succeeded, 0 failed**, 119 files, 234.27 MiB, **1 minute 33 seconds**. This is one fixture run, not a benchmark against the previous release.
- Floating base and one position-controlled joint: USD gains **80/4**, MJCF gains **25/2**. Applying, reopening and a complete SolidWorks restart all preserved the settings independently.
- MuJoCo 3.12.0 compiled both XML entry points; original XML and MJB independently loaded and advanced one zero-control step. OpenUSD 0.26.8 reopened the stage and resolved 15 mesh dependencies.
- All **154 original CAD file hashes remained unchanged**; tests used an isolated copy.

### Installation and limits

This is a **pre-release**, not the stable Latest release. Back up your assemblies, close every SolidWorks process, install the x64 package as administrator, then restart SolidWorks. The installer is not Authenticode-signed.

This does not validate every SW version or DPI arrangement, Isaac Sim/PhysX/Newton, long-running simulations, controller tuning or training tasks. Initial preview can still be slow. Unverified local CSV roundtrip and no-auto-save development changes are **not included**.

[English handbook](https://osrbot.github.io/solidworks_urdf_exporter_pro/en/) · [acceptance record](https://github.com/osrbot/solidworks_urdf_exporter_pro/blob/master/docs/reviews/2026-09-07-shared-simulation-settings.md)

## 简体中文

### 相比 v20260906 的变化

- OpenUSD 和 MJCF 共用 **“仿真设置”**：统一选择基座模式和关节驱动意图，两个子标签分别填写增益。保存装配体并重启 SolidWorks 后仍可恢复。
- 直接输入 Link 实测质量即可校准完整惯性矩阵，不必先恢复 SW 值，不会修改 CAD 零部件的质量属性。预览与导出共用结果；质量和惯性同比缩放时，等效长方体尺寸不变是正常现象。
- 导出坐标系和 STL 设置以实际生效状态为准，不再把设置调用返回值直接当作成功依据；按正确顺序恢复相互关联的 STL 精度设置。
- 修复取消保存失败后树为空、Mimic 大小写匹配错误，以及 ROS 专属配置错误拦截其他目标。
- 修复初始 DPI 缩放、部分控件溢出和仿真子标签布局问题。

### 测试范围

- 沿用源码 `a422ed7` 在 9 月 7 日构建的原安装包，已在远端 SolidWorks 2023 SP1 安装并测试。
- Core **129 项**、官方 MuJoCo **9 项**、插件 **992 项**通过，无失败或跳过。
- 实际四目标导出 **4 成功、0 失败**：119 个文件、234.27 MiB、**1 分 33 秒**。这是单次测试副本结果，不是与旧版的性能对比。
- 浮动基座、一个位置控制关节，USD 增益 **80/4**、MJCF **25/2**。应用、重开设置和完全重启 SolidWorks 后，参数均独立保留。
- MuJoCo 3.12.0 编译两个 XML 入口，原始 XML 与 MJB 均独立加载并执行一步零控制仿真。OpenUSD 0.26.8 重新打开场景，成功解析 15 个网格依赖。
- 使用独立副本验收，原始 **154 个 CAD 文件哈希全部未变**。

### 安装和限制

这是**候选版（Pre-release）**，不替换正式版 Latest。先备份装配体，关闭所有 SolidWorks 进程，以管理员身份安装 x64 安装包，再重启 SolidWorks。安装包未做 Authenticode 签名。

不代表所有 SW 版本、DPI 组合、Isaac Sim/PhysX/Newton、长时间仿真、控制器调参或训练任务均已验证。首次预览仍可能较慢。开发区尚未验收的 CSV 几何往返和取消自动保存改动**没有包含在本版中**。
